name: Blur Reveal Accordion
description: Interactive accordion with synchronized height expansion and smooth letter-by-letter blur text reveals.
summary: An ultra-smooth accordion with character-by-character optical blur reveal physics, spring-calibrated toggle morphing, and synchronized height transitions. Features click-outside auto-collapse, dark/light adaptive styling, and customizable spring physics for silky-smooth typography blooming.
highlights: Staggered letter-by-letter blur-to-sharp optical reveal animation
Spring-calibrated morphing indicator transitioning smoothly between plus and minus
Sub-pixel calibrated height transitions with zero layout shift
Automatic click-outside detection to dismiss expanded panels
Full word-boundary containment preventing mid-word line breaks during stagger
Complete prefers-reduced-motion fallback ensuring instant zero-latency transitions
anatomy: <Accordion> (Root container with gradient background shell and click-outside handler)
<button> (Accessible toggle header with animated morphing plus/minus indicator)
<BlurText> (Character-by-character blooming typography engine with spring physics)

physics.description: Dual-axis height bezier curve combined with per-character optical blur dissolving and spring dampening.

accessibility.aria: Uses semantic button triggers with live aria-expanded state and aria-label accessibility on animated blur text.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Instantaneous height and opacity changes with blur filter disabled when prefers-reduced-motion is active.

keyboard.description: Expand or collapse the focused accordion item.

recommended: Product FAQ sections and documentation feature breakdowns
Feature highlights where dramatic typography reveals enhance storytelling
Settings drawers and expandable guidance cards in developer consoles
bestPractices: Keep descriptions under 250 characters for optimal staggered reveal pacing
Use closeOnClickOutside for interactive drawers in compact layouts
Enable reduced-motion fallbacks for users with vestibular sensitivities

props.name: items
props.description: Array of items containing title and description strings to render in the accordion.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: Index of the item that should be open by default on mount.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Whether clicking an active item closes it.

props.name: letterDelay
props.description: Custom stagger delay in seconds between consecutive characters.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Spring stiffness coefficient for the vertical letter translation.

props.name: damping
props.description: Spring damping coefficient to control bouncing on letter arrival.

props.name: blurAmount
props.description: Initial blur filter radius in pixels before dissolving into sharpness.

props.name: closeOnClickOutside
props.description: Whether clicking outside the accordion automatically closes any open items.
